cohort: 7365 pregnant women in Lhasa, Tibet who gave birth at a tertiary care institution between 2012 and 2015
finding: The study found a steady decline in the annual rate of cesarean section in women in Tibet between 2012 and 2015, largely due to a decrease in emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The annual rate of emergency cesarean section declined 53.9% between 2012 and 2015.
